svg.text: S · same-run first request: fresh process launch through response and reap
Each bar sums mean phase timings from the same three processes; total range is observed min–max, not a confidence interval.
Linear wall ms; each engine has its own labelled scale. Resident/prepared/fork observations stay outside this fresh-process chart.
Old Pysolate source stage is Host adaptation only. Guest Python compilation and instance initialization remain inside Runner.Run execution.
Runtime init includes first imports/setup; Rust source preparation includes compile. Pyodide includes real Wasm load/instantiate + Python harness imports.
